mapper.sql: select data_id, batch_id, crop_type, variety_code, variety_name, breeding_method, batch_name, germplasm_source, parental_seed_source, objective, year, status, workflow_status, remarks, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted from breeding_batch
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('BREED', #{year}, LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(batch_id, 11) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 6, '0')) FROM breeding_batch WHERE batch_id LIKE CONCAT('BREED', #{year}, '%')

SELECT CONCAT('B_', #{cropType}, '_', #{year}, '_', LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(batch_id, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 6, '0')) FROM breeding_batch WHERE batch_id LIKE CONCAT('B_', #{cropType}, '_', #{year}, '_%') AND is_deleted = 0

select data_id, batch_id, batch_name, crop_type, variety_code, variety_name, germplasm_source, parental_seed_source, objective, year, status,workflow_status from breeding_batch where is_deleted = 0 order by create_time desc
